description: This class provides service-layer operations for managing Author entities within the book project, including CRUD operations and counting authors.

classes.name: AuthorService
classes.description: Service class for managing authors, providing methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and counting author records.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves an author by their unique ID, returning an Optional that may contain the author if found.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all authors in the repository.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a new author or updates an existing one in the repository.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified author from the repository.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Removes all author records from the repository.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of author records.
